title: PRISM: Promoting Sampling Diversity of Large Language Models with Implicit Stochastic Modulation
abstract: arXiv:2610.32101v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit mode collapse, where their output distribution concentrates on familiar semantic modes. When diversity disappears, repeated sampling becomes semantic repetition rather than discovery, making rare but stronger solutions unlikely to surface and leaving self-evolution and continual learning difficult to sustain. Most remedies intervene only at inference time, shaping sam- ples without making diversity a model capability. We propose PRISM, a training-time framework that internalizes diversity within the model. PRISM combines (i) submodular curation that pairs each prompt with diverse-yet-correct multi-teacher solutions, and (ii) stochastic embedding modulation, which turns special-token perturbations into implicit signals for sampling distinct outputs. A theoretical analysis establishes the stability of this mechanism. On WritingPrompts and BookMIA, PRISM moves the quality-diversity frontier outward, achi

translated_title: PRISM：通过隐式随机调制促进大语言模型的采样多样性
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）存在模式坍缩问题，即其输出分布会集中于熟悉的语义模式。当多样性消失时，重复采样只会带来语义上的重复而非新的发现，使得罕见但更优的解难以浮现，也让自我进化与持续学习难以维系。现有的大多数补救方法仅在推理时进行干预，只是对样本进行塑形，而没有将多样性转化为模型自身的一种能力。我们提出PRISM，这是一个训练时框架，将多样性内化到模型之中。PRISM结合了两个核心组件：(i) 次模数据筛选，为每个提示配对多样且正确的多教师解法；(ii) 随机嵌入调制，将特殊token的扰动转化为隐式信号，促使模型采样出不同的输出。理论分析证明了该机制的稳定性。在WritingPrompts和BookMIA数据集上，PRISM将质量-多样性前沿向外推移，取得……
tldr: PRISM是一个训练时框架，通过次模数据筛选与随机嵌入调制两种机制，将采样多样性内化为大语言模型自身的能力，从而突破质量-多样性的权衡前沿。
en_tdlr: PRISM is a training-time framework that internalizes sampling diversity as a model capability in LLMs by combining submodular curation of diverse-yet-correct multi-teacher solutions with stochastic embedding modulation, pushing the quality-diversity frontier outward.
